record.paper_title: Mapping current and activity fluctuations in exclusion processes: consequences and open questions
record.context_brief: Possible critical behavior in open SSEP activity fluctuations
record.original_question: For the open SSEP with equal boundary reservoir densities ρ_a = ρ_b = 1/2, conditioned by activity in the diffusive scaling s = λ/L², is there critical behavior near λ = −π²/2, possibly including the onset of power-law correlations, even though the mapped WASEP criterion predicts no particle-hole symmetry breaking for ν₁ = 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the open one-dimensional symmetric simple exclusion process (SSEP) on a lattice of L sites, in which each particle attempts to hop to each nearest-neighbor empty site at rate 1, and the boundary sites 1 and L are coupled to particle reservoirs of densities ρ_a and ρ_b respectively (so particles are injected/removed at the two ends at rates compatible with these reservoir densities). Let A_t denote the dynamical activity up to time t, defined as the total number of particle jumps (in either direction, across any bond, including boundary exchanges) performed by the process during the time interval [0, t]. For a real parameter λ, define the tilted (activity-conditioned) generating function

  Z_L(λ, t) = E[ exp(λ A_t) ],

and consider the diffusive scaling λ = s L² with s held fixed as L → ∞.

Take the symmetric reservoir choice ρ_a = ρ_b = 1/2. A formal mapping of the activity-tilted SSEP to a weakly asymmetric exclusion process (WASEP) yields a quantitative criterion for spontaneous breaking of particle–hole symmetry that, in the SSEP limit (asymmetry parameter ν₁ = 0), predicts no symmetry-breaking interval for any value of λ.

Question: In this setting, does the activity-conditioned open SSEP nevertheless exhibit critical behavior in a neighborhood of the value λ = −π²/2 (equivalently, of the rescaled value s = −π²/2 in the diffusive scaling, after replacing L by 1)? In particular, do power-law spatial correlations of the conditioned density profile emerge as λ approaches −π²/2, even though no particle–hole symmetry breaking occurs?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches on activity large deviations for the open SSEP at the symmetric point ρ_a=ρ_b=1/2 and on critical behavior near λ = −π²/2 do not return any results that confirm or refute the existence of a critical point with power-law correlations there. Recent works on SSEP large deviations (e.g., slow-boundary SSEP, WASEP large-deviation functionals) do not appear to settle this specific question, so the status remains unknown.

status_evidence.title: Large deviations in the symmetric simple exclusion process with slow boundaries
status_evidence.snippet: Studies SSEP large deviations with slow boundaries; does not address activity-tilted critical behavior at λ=-π²/2.
status_evidence.claim: Recent SSEP large-deviation literature does not address the conjectured critical point near λ=-π²/2 for activity in the open SSEP.

status_evidence.title: Large Deviations for the SSEP with slow boundary: the non-critical case
status_evidence.snippet: Treats non-critical regimes for SSEP with slow boundaries.
status_evidence.claim: No evidence resolving the activity-conditioned critical behavior question for symmetric reservoirs.
